description: Trigger evals for the Juke spaces embed skill. Should-trigger queries cover varied phrasings of 'add live Farcaster audio rooms'. Should-not-trigger queries are near-misses — adjacent audio, adjacent Farcaster, adjacent embeds — that should NOT pull the Juke skill.
